text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours with BTC showing slightly more pressure, while Bitcoin's dominance has climbed to 56.4%, suggesting capital is rotating toward the safest major asset during uncertainty. The Fear & Greed index at 29 remains in fear territory and has held relatively stable over the past week, indicating sustained caution rather than panic capitulation. Volume at $66B is moderate, typical of a consolidation phase where participants are waiting for clearer directional signals before committing fresh capital.
